acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using BasSekolah.my ("the Platform"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

service.title: 2. Description of service
service.body: BasSekolah.my provides fleet management, student enrollment, and billing tools for Malaysian school bus operators, and a companion portal for parents to track applications, routes, and payments.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts
accounts.body: Bus operators are responsible for the accuracy of the fleet, staff, and route information they enter, and for approving student applications. Parents are responsible for the accuracy of the information they submit about their children. Each account may only be used by the person or organisation it was created for.

fees.title: 4. Fees and payment
fees.body: The Free plan carries no monthly subscription fee. BasSekolah.my charges RM1 per active student and RM1 per transaction collected, both deducted automatically from the parent's payment at the point of collection via our payment gateway, ToyyibPay. Operators are never billed separately for these fees. Pricing for additional plans will be published before they become available.

responsibilities.title: 5. Operator responsibilities
responsibilities.body: Operators are solely responsible for the safe operation of their bus fleet, the accuracy of billing amounts, and compliance with applicable transport and safety regulations. BasSekolah.my is a management and billing tool only, and does not operate, own, or supervise any bus service.

data.title: 6. Data and privacy
data.body: Your use of the Platform is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and protect personal data, including data belonging to students.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.body: You may stop using the Platform at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, misuse the Platform, or engage in fraudulent activity.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of liability
liability.body: The Platform is provided "as is". To the fullest extent permitted by law, BasSekolah.my is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the Platform, including delays, missed payments, or transport incidents.

changes.title: 9. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

contact.title: 10. Contact us
contact.body: Questions about these Terms? Reach us at hello@bassekolah.my or via our Contact page.

collect.title: 1. Information we collect
collect.body: We collect account information (name, email, phone) for operators and parents; student information (name, date of birth, school, route) submitted by parents or operators; and payment records (amount, method, date) processed through ToyyibPay. We never store full card or bank account numbers ourselves.

use.title: 2. How we use information
use.body: We use this information to operate the Platform: managing enrollments, generating invoices, calculating discounts, processing payments, and providing customer support.

sharing.title: 3. Data sharing
sharing.body: BasSekolah.my is multi-tenant — each bus operator's data is isolated and never visible to other operators. Parent and student data is only visible to the parent's own bus operator and to BasSekolah.my platform administrators for support and billing purposes.

security.title: 4. Data security
security.body: Data is encrypted in transit, and access to each operator's data is enforced at the database level. Platform administrator access is limited to what's needed for support and billing.

retention.title: 5. Data retention
retention.body: We retain account, enrollment, and billing records for as long as the account is active, and as required by Malaysian tax and record-keeping regulations.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.body: Under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA), you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us. Parents may also update their own and their child's details directly from their portal.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in securely. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.

children.title: 8. Children's data
children.body: Student data is submitted and managed by a parent or guardian, or by the bus operator on their behalf. We do not knowingly collect data directly from children.

changes.title: 9. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected with a new "last updated" date.

contact.title: 10. Contact us
contact.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Reach us at hello@bassekolah.my or via our Contact page.

findOperator.question: How do I find my child's bus operator?
findOperator.answer: Ask your school bus operator for their 4-digit operator code, then enter it on the homepage to find their workspace and register instantly.

billing.question: How is my bill calculated?
billing.answer: Your operator sets a base monthly fee per route. Discounts for longer billing cycles and multiple children are applied automatically and itemized on every invoice.

payment.question: How do I pay?
payment.answer: From your dashboard, tap Pay now to settle your current bill or your full outstanding balance in one go. Payments your operator records are reflected instantly.

changeDetails.question: Can I update my child's route or details?
changeDetails.answer: Yes — reach out to your bus operator directly. They manage route assignments and can update your child's enrollment from their side.

receipts.question: Can I get a receipt for my payment?
receipts.answer: Every paid invoice has a downloadable PDF receipt available from your dashboard, itemized with your operator's details for your records.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Each operator's data is fully isolated on BasSekolah.my — your information is only ever visible to your own bus operator and platform administrators.

operatorsPage.faqSubtitle: Everything operators usually ask before signing up.

free.question: Is BasSekolah.my really free?
free.answer: There's no monthly subscription — you only pay RM1 per active student and RM1 per transaction, both deducted automatically from each parent's payment. No setup fees, no credit card required.

setup.question: How long does setup take?
setup.answer: Most operators are live within a day: add your buses, drivers, and routes, then share your 4-digit operator code with parents to start collecting applications.

billing.question: How does billing and collection work?
billing.answer: Configure your base fees and discount rules once — BasSekolah.my calculates each family's bill automatically by billing cycle and sibling count, and tracks who's paid.

dataIsolation.question: Is my fleet and student data private?
dataIsolation.answer: Yes — BasSekolah.my is fully multi-tenant. Your buses, staff, routes, students, and finances are never visible to other operators on the platform.

parentsRegister.question: How do parents register?
parentsRegister.answer: Share your 4-digit operator code. Parents enter it on the homepage, submit a short application, and you approve or reject it from your dashboard.

hiddenFees.question: Are there any hidden fees?
hiddenFees.answer: No — RM1 per student and RM1 per transaction, deducted from parent payments, is the only fee BasSekolah.my charges. No setup fees, no monthly minimums, no surprises.

about.headline: Built for the school run.
about.paragraph1: Most Malaysian school bus operators still run their fleet, enrollment, and billing out of spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups — hard to track who owes what, which child is on which bus, and slow to onboard new families every term.
about.paragraph2: BasSekolah.my brings fleet management, an application-and-approval enrollment flow, and automatic monthly billing into one bilingual workspace — built to be simple for operators to set up, and transparent for parents to use.
about.paragraph3: Every application is reviewed before a child is added to a route, every invoice recalculates automatically with the right discounts, and every parent can see exactly which bus, driver, and stop their child is assigned to.
